tasks.title: [r2-retry-status] isRetryableR2Status: which R2 reply statuses are worth retrying
tasks.body:
Target: PeaceG03/PeaceSTOCKS

add function `isRetryableR2Status(status: number): boolean` to `src/r2-retry-status.ts` returning status === 429 || (500 <= status && status <= 599)
- isRetryableR2Status(500) is true
- isRetryableR2Status(503) is true
- isRetryableR2Status(599) is true
- isRetryableR2Status(429) is true
- isRetryableR2Status(404) is false
- isRetryableR2Status(403) is false
- isRetryableR2Status(200) is false
- isRetryableR2Status(600) is false

(Builder pre-file, ADD_FUNCTION, public-add-function-v2): Peace's task (source: peace). The ten-minute chain stopped on R2_PUT_500 (run 39451888891) and R2_GET_500 (run 39467160610) because R2ObjectClient.request never retries; this is the status test the future retry uses: 5xx and 429 retry, every other status does not. Production safety: one new pure function in a new module plus one new src/*.test.ts file only: nothing imports it yet, so the running scanner, the scan and the ten-minute chain are unchanged. Wiring it in is a separate task that needs a skill PeaceAI does not have yet (see batch-v4/scanner/DIAGNOSIS.md). Job B grades it against itself: the new test passes with the function and fails with the source put back. A box dry-run on PeaceSTOCKS 0ab37c8 (Workspace main 1e8448a, live 30-rule approved list, Node 20) built exactly one candidate (public-add-function-v2); a local Job B run graded it COUNTS (the new test passes with the function and fails with its body stubbed); suite 599/599, all 4 typechecks ok. Disjoint file: each task in this batch creates its own new module and test file. Expected COUNTS.)

tasks.title: [r2-retry-delay] r2RetryDelayMs: bounded backoff for an R2 retry attempt
tasks.body:
Target: PeaceG03/PeaceSTOCKS

add function `r2RetryDelayMs(attempt: number, baseMs: number): number` to `src/r2-retry-delay.ts` returning Math.min(baseMs * (attempt + 1) * (attempt + 1), 30000)
- r2RetryDelayMs(0, 1000) is 1000
- r2RetryDelayMs(1, 1000) is 4000
- r2RetryDelayMs(2, 1000) is 9000
- r2RetryDelayMs(10, 1000) is 30000
- r2RetryDelayMs(0, 0) is 0

(Builder pre-file, ADD_FUNCTION, public-add-function-v2): Peace's task (source: peace). tasks.title: [host-failure-line] hostFailureLine: host failure line that keeps the error cause code
tasks.body:
